g.text: RF-Power-Monitor: flash layout and which firmware starts
Boot program (boot/, runs from 0x100 after boot2)
Why the reset? power-on, RUN pin,
Both boot record copies: the newest
valid one; target = its trial slot,
else its active slot (none: slot A)
Start the target: slot, reason and
No request with the network up
10 min, or 1 h in all: record back
The boot program only reads the boot record;
the firmware writes it (two copies, newest
valid wins). A planned restart is not a crash.
